# Sample Repository for Knowledge Graph Testing

This is a minimal Rust project designed to test the knowledge graph generation functionality.

## Structure
- `src/main.rs` - Simple binary with basic functions
- `src/lib.rs` - Library with public API
- `src/utils/mod.rs` - Utility module
- `src/config.rs` - Configuration handling
- `Cargo.toml` - Project dependencies

## Purpose
Provides a realistic but simple codebase for testing:
- Entity extraction (functions, structs, modules)
- Relationship detection (function calls, imports)
- Dependency analysis
- Architecture understanding
